messages:
anya: Heads up — we need to settle the telemetry retention/window granularity for the reprocess UI. Options on the table: 15m, 1h, 6h, daily. Cost vs precision tradeoffs.

maria: What's the immediate driver here? Is this for the EU late aggregates we saw?

anya: Yeah — late ingest spikes over the weekend show a lot of narrow hot windows. Hourly windows hide those spikes and produce noisy aggregates; 15m windows are more accurate but explode the number of reprocess slots and backend jobs.

sam: Also worth flagging: query pressure. If we allow arbitrary 15m ranges across months, the planner will generate tons of range reads and dashboard queries will spike.

josh: Quick proposal to discuss: 15m for <=7d lookbacks, 1h for 7–90d, daily for >90d. Default to 1h in the UI. That balances precision for recent issues and cost for older data.

maria: That seems reasonable. How do we bill quota units? Each 15m slot should count as one unit, so a 3-hour range at 15m granularity = 12 units. Need to avoid surprise charges.

anya: Agreed. Server-side calculation should be deterministic: units = ceil(range_seconds / slot_seconds). We'll surface that in the UI before confirm.

lee: UI notes: show a single-line estimate "Estimated quota units: X" and an ETA estimate based on current queue depth. Also show a toggle to expand a detailed slot list for power users.

sam: Routing concern: heavy reprocess jobs must be routed to the reprocess priority lane so prod inference endpoints don't see latency regressions. We need per-tenant throttles and a global admission control.

replay-bot: [automated] current replayer concurrency: 42 jobs, slot capacity: 200, priority-lane used: 1

josh: On the infra side, we can reuse the slot allocator + prewarm KV cache for adjacent windows to speed repeated small-range replays. Short windows benefit a lot from caching.

anya: Security/compliance note — for Private deployments we should default to more conservative windows (1h) since customers may have quota policies and we don't want runaway on-prem jobs.

maria: Governance: propose a gating rule — any request >100 units requires SRE/Platform signoff. That prevents accidental org-wide replays.

sam: I'll take the server-side API sketch: endpoint /replay/estimate and /replay/submit will return units, ETA, and required-approvals. I'll try to prod a design doc by EOD.

lee: I'll mock the UI (Figma) and post the link in this thread. Will include the "estimated units" + cost tooltip.

anya: Action items recap: (1) server-side deterministic slot & quota API (sam), (2) console UX for estimated units/ETA and slot toggle (lee), (3) gating rule >100 units -> SRE signoff (maria), (4) routing to priority lane + per-tenant throttles (sam/josh).

maria: LGTM :thumbsup:

sam: will post API sketch shortly

lee: mock uploaded https://figma.com/s/telemetry-replay-ui-mock (will update)

anya: Thanks team — adding this to tomorrow's standup agenda.

infra-bot: [deploy] replayer:slot-calculator v0.3 deployed to staging

anya: great — staging deploy helps validate estimate calc. I'll run a small dry-run tomorrow morning.
